hooks.text: 每局重连 2,000 个星区，并让五区域经济随供需、距离、矿难和禁运变化，同时每 2,000 回合进入新纪元。
hooks.excerpt: ▸ 2,000 sectors, procedurally rewired every run. No two galaxies are the same. ▸ A five-zone economy that reacts to supply, demand, distance, and sudden shocks like mining collapses and tech embargoes. ▸ Epoch shifts every 2,000 turns: pirate uprisings, trade booms, and faction wars across six eras before the Final Epoch locks in.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 商人、战士、探索者、外交家与殖民者五条职业路径分别对应独立终局目标。
hooks.excerpt: FIVE PATHS. FIVE ENDGAMES. ▸ Trader, navigate and dominate the galactic market. ▸ Warrior, wiping the scourge of pirates from the map. ▸ Explorer, the map filled corner to corner. ▸ Diplomat, every great power calling you ally. ▸ Settler, a frontier stitched with your colonies.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 八套可调 CRT 预设与可定制界面，可在七十年代终端到九十年代特效显示之间塑造复古科幻观感。
hooks.excerpt: ▸ Eight customizable CRT presets, with fine tunable settings that can make the game a crisp flat panel to a full retro burn pixellated vintage throwback. ▸ Customizable UI to make it as spartan as a '70s terminal to a glorious '90s effects display.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
